title: Webhook Triggers Settings
description: Trigger external webhooks from YouTrack events. Webhook endpoints, the events each one subscribes to, and a per-endpoint signing token are configured through the Webhooks settings widget on the project's Apps page.

webhooksJson.title: Webhooks
webhooksJson.description: JSON-encoded list of webhook endpoints, each with its own URL, signing token, and subscribed events. Managed by the Webhooks settings widget — the YouTrack settings schema only allows entity-backed arrays, so this structured list is stored as a JSON string. Field validation (required URL, token min length, event selection) lives in the widget, since the schema cannot validate values inside this string.

headerName.title: Header name
headerName.description: The HTTP header name that carries each endpoint's signing token in outgoing requests.
